item.title: Hewitt-Trussville High School wins national competition
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. (TRIBUNE) — The Hewitt-Trussville Varsity Cheerleaders powered their way to the 2026 National Championship on Saturday night. The loudest Huskies delivered nearly flawless routines to win the National High School Cheerleading Championship in the Super Varsity Division with a final score of 87.25.
